name: OpenDS Sync
description: Push your Penpot library — design tokens and components — to a self-hosted OpenDS instance. Connect with an instance URL and API key, then sync automatically while the panel is open, or pick exactly what to sync.

features.name: Design token sync
features.description: Extract and push colors, typography and spacing tokens to your OpenDS instance

features.name: Component sync
features.description: Push library components to OpenDS as review-pending components, deduplicated by name

features.name: Auto-sync while open
features.description: Syncs once on open/connect and watches the library for changes, pushing automatically

features.name: Choose what to sync
features.description: Sync everything, only tokens, only components, or a hand-picked set of components
